test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are six members of a family. There are parents, their children and grandchildren in the family. A is the son of C and E is the daughter of A. D is the daughter of F who is the mother of E. Which of the following pairs is the grandchildren of the parents?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0634b524b013097d361d40acb3f433749c8ad65eceeabfeb06f3b682eb43ad71.png] 

The family tree can be drawn as per the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93f218d09ef5df69b8c3d14ba0fabb5a75a7be57a8641f7706c5103a650ada2c.png] 

Here, we can see that the pair 'D, E' represents the grandchildren.

Hence, the correct answer is **"D, E"**.
